correctness.rationale: At stationary Poisson rate r>0 and |Q|<=c<1, the generator Lx=-lambda1 x and Lx³=6Dx-lambda3 x³ closes the odd polynomial sector. From stationary M2=2D/lambda2 and M4=12DM2/lambda4 and exact semigroup we derive Delta=E[X0 Xt³-X0³Xt]=(6DM2-M4(lambda3-lambda1))H(t), with H positive difference-of-exponentials divided by rate gap (or t exp at equality). The amplitude factors as 6DM2 E[(1-Q)^3(1+Q)]/(1-m4)>0; hence strict positivity for every t>0 and a unique maximum at logarithmic mean time. Mixed terms vanish for independent centered stationary reversible V, preserving Delta even for colored non-Gaussian noise. Independent matrix-semigroup calculation for a four-point signed Q law gave 0.6355953304270984 vs 0.6355953304270994, proving only sample agreement; algebra holds for arbitrary bounded signed Q.
